#include <iostream>

#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const ll MOD = 998244353LL;

ll mod_pow(ll base, ll exp, ll mod) {
    ll result = 1;
    base %= mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
    }
    return result;
}

ll mod_inv(ll a, ll mod) {
    return mod_pow(a, mod - 2, mod);
}

int main() {
    ll n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;
    ll k = n * m;
    ll len = r - l + 1;

    if (k % 2 == 1) {
        cout << mod_pow(len, k, MOD) << endl;
    } else {
        ll ans = (mod_pow(len, k, MOD) + mod_pow(len % 2, k, MOD)) * mod_inv(2, MOD) % MOD;
        cout << ans << endl;
    }

    return 0;
}
